newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere rises on bargain-buying, upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere rises on bargain-buying, upgrade.

text.p: Shares in conglomerate Lagardere, which have fallen heavily recently, rebounded on Tuesday on cheap buying and a recommendation from NatWest Sellier, brokers and fund managers said.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell renewed its buy recommendation, saying there was an excessive discount relative to a net asset value of between 210 and 220 francs per share.
Lagardere shares were up 4.03 percent at 165.30 francs on volume of 373,728 shares at 1153 GMT.
NatWest Sellier pointed to the stock's fundamentals, strong growth prospects and the discount on revalued net assets.
NatWest Sellier also viewed Lagardere's position in European defence as unstoppable, taking into account its alliances with British Aerospace Plc and Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG.
Lagardere shares have dropped 13 percent since the past week on doubts over the Thomson-CSF privatisation for which it is bidding against Alcatel Alsthom.
Lagardere lost 6.42 percent alone on Monday. CDC Bourse maintained the stock on its recommended list on Monday.

"Lagardere is a stock with a heavy discount and has great potential, and which even if it does not take over Thomson, it can ally itself with other industrial partners. At the present share price, one can take risks," a fund manager said.
Lagardere forecast at its annual shareholders meeting last Friday it would enjoy average annual double digit profit growth to 2001.
